Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National WPL 2026/27: Hasaacas, Police Ladies remain unbeaten as FC Savannah stay top in Northern Zone Source : Lawrence Degraft Baidoo 9 November 2026 9:00am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The 2026/27 GoldFields Women's Premier League continues to take shape after three weeks of action across the Southern and Northern Zones.
Police Ladies and Hasaacas Ladies continued their impressive start to the campaign, claiming maximum points over the weekend in their respective games.
Police Ladies came from a goal down to claim all three points against newly promoted Rootz Sistaz, with Sophia Agyaakwa's brace cancelling out Jacqueline Amponsah's early strike. The league's debutants are still without a win in three games following their promotion.
At the Madina Astro Turf, Belinda Kpoglo scored twice from the penalty spot as Hasaacas maintained an unbeaten record in their meetings with Epiphany Warriors as they picked up a 2-1 win. Jessica Appiah Asamoah scored Epiphany's only goal as they also waited for a victory this season.
Army Ladies were held to a goalless draw at home by Hearts of Oak Ladies at the Teshie Mats Park, while Immigration Ladies claimed their first point of the season with a 1-1 game against Jonina Ladies.
Samartex Ladies claimed an emphatic victory over LadyStrikers on Sunday, picking up a 3-0 win at home for their first win of the season.
In the Northern Zone, FC Savannah made it two wins in a row to stay top after beating Dreamz Ladies with a 2-0 scoreline at home.
Northern Ladies also picked up their first victory of the campaign as they defeated Prisons Ladies by a goal to nil, while Tamale Super Ladies secured all three points with a 3-1 away win over Fosu Royal Ladies.
Ashanti Ladies fell to Supreme Ladies 3-0 on the road as their consistent run of form continued.
